entities.name: Seble
entities.description: A Zendikari elf skyrider on a blue and white flying manta, part of Gideon's forces.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: Planeswalker who commanded the army at Zendikar.

entities.name: Smothering abomination
entities.description: An Eldrazi flying creature that approached refugees.

events.summary: Seble warned Gideon of a smothering abomination approaching refugees; Gideon joined her on the manta and they brought it down.
events.quote: Gideon joined Seble on the manta, and they flew up to meet the Eldrazi in the air

events.summary: Seble cheered Gideon's plan to reclaim the Sea Gate and took part in the battle.
events.quote: participated in the battle to take it back

events.summary: Seble first spotted the Titan Ulamog on the horizon, headed for them.
events.quote: She was the first to spot it, looming on the distant horizon

relations.quote: part of Gideon 's forces during the Battle for Zendikar
